t: Amazon grows its roster of grocery delivery partners | Grocery Dive
s: May 21, 2024 - The retailer giant announced Monday it is now offering same-day two-hour grocery delivery from Lucky Supermarkets in select cities across the San Francisco Bay Area. Amazon shoppers in the San Francisco area can buy groceries, alcohol, household items, healthy and beauty products and baby products from Lucky using the e-commerce company’s website.
